unit: US dollars per hour for a machine of 4 vCPU and about 8 GiB, list price, excluding tax, the disk and a public address; a row names its own shape where it differs
note: Entered by hand from each provider's own page or public price data. Where the provider lists euro, the dollar figure is the euro price at 1.18 dollars to the euro, the rate Hetzner's own two price columns imply, and the note says so.

machines.name: Azure Spot, F4s v2 (East US)
machines.note: Evicted with 30 seconds' notice and no SLA; the price varies; billing granularity was not read, so a part hour is counted as a whole one.

machines.name: Oracle Arm A1, pay-as-you-go (4 OCPU, 8 GB)
machines.note: 4 x $0.01 per OCPU-hour and 8 x $0.0015 per GB-hour; per second with a one-minute minimum; a boot volume is extra; the Always Free allowance was halved in 2026.

machines.name: Scaleway DEV1-L (Paris)
machines.note: EUR 0.04284 an hour at 1.18 dollars to the euro; a powered-off machine is not billed for compute but its volumes and address are; stock and quota were not checked.

machines.name: Vultr vc2-4c-8gb
machines.note: $40 a month cap; hourly billing with a one-hour minimum; only destroying the server stops the charge.

machines.name: Hetzner CPX32 (Germany, Finland)
machines.note: EUR 0.0569 an hour, $0.0673 in Hetzner's own dollar column; the price rose 154% on 2026-06-15; new customers may not be able to create servers; the cheaper CX and CAX lines are marked unavailable. The monthly price is Hetzner's own dollar column (EUR 35.49).

machines.name: DigitalOcean Basic, 4 vCPU and 8 GiB
machines.note: $48 a month cap; per second with a 60-second minimum since 2026-01-01; a powered-off Droplet is billed.

machines.name: Linode 8 GB
machines.note: Rounded up to the hour, capped at the monthly price; a powered-off Linode keeps accruing.

machines.name: AWS On-Demand, c6g.xlarge (US East)
machines.note: Arm (Graviton); the same shape on x86 is dearer; one-minute minimum; the default quota for a new account is 5 vCPUs.

machines.name: Koyeb Eco, eco-xlarge (4 vCPU, 8 GB)
machines.note: $0.000016 a second; a paused service is not billed; the page does not say whether the vCPU is shared or dedicated; Eco is for development and non-production; Koyeb is being acquired by Mistral AI and new users can sign up only for Pro and above ($29 a month plus compute).

machines.name: Hetzner CCX23 (4 dedicated vCPU, 16 GB)
machines.note: EUR 0.1378 an hour, $0.1626 in Hetzner's own dollar column, from 2026-06-15 (it was $0.0593); a full month is billed at the $101.49 cap; the page marks the CCX types unavailable, which may be a no-script fallback.
